rule: Identify the originating source as Crackling Tunes; retain native source provenance.
Preserve the complete source-relative path; the asset is not the performance itself.
Preserve directory hierarchy as source evidence; use semantic extraction only where a CT rule is established.
Retain filename verbatim; use filename CT identifiers and dates as fallback evidence.
Preserve the CT monthly release representation; release_id was already established by the validated CT transition.
Prefer embedded CATALOG #; preserve the complete native value and decompose side/take without treating it as a canonical Performance key.
Fallback: extract the CT identifier from the filename when embedded CATALOG # is absent and the CT pattern is unambiguous.
Interpret the first slash-delimited component as an ensemble candidate; retain the complete ARTIST expression as source evidence.
Interpret named components after the slash as performer/singer candidates; do not assume every remaining component is a singer without context.
Derive instrumental status from the source participant marker; do not create a Person entity for Instr./Instrumental.
Retain complete ALBUMARTIST as source evidence; bracketed ensemble type is evidence, not proof of leadership.
For comparison only, normalize case/accents/punctuation and remove frequency annotations such as 435Hz/440Hz; preserve original title.
Convert filename date to ISO date when present; preserve source value and do not manufacture precision.
Represent supplied date at its supported precision; retain conflicts as separate source assertions.
Preserve CT side as a source identifier component.
Preserve CT take designation as source evidence; do not assume it uniquely identifies a historical performance.
Preserve source representation format as an asset property.
Where the corresponding release exists in the supplied TANGO-DJ snapshot, retain its external ref; never substitute it for the MusicStewardship internal identity.
Keep external values as separate evidence; native Crackling Tunes values remain source assertions.

source_pattern: anything not covered by established CT rule
rule: Do not discard unrecognized values; retain them as residual source evidence.
Treat absence from a particular TANGO-DJ snapshot as an unresolved cross-reference, not a Crackling Tunes source error.

source_pattern: multiple source values for same property
rule: Do not collapse conflicting source values; preserve each assertion and provenance for later reconciliation.
